orders: Formal assessment of extraocular movements in all six cardinal directions of gaze, documenting any limitation of adduction or abduction
Cover-uncover test to assess for strabismus or phoria at primary gaze
Test for convergence by having patient follow a target brought toward the nose
MRI brain and orbits with gadolinium contrast to look for demyelinating lesions in the brainstem (particularly the medial longitudinal fasciculus) and periventricular white matter
Comprehensive metabolic panel and complete blood count
CSF analysis with oligoclonal bands if MRI suggests demyelination
Anti-GAD65 antibodies (glutamic acid decarboxylase) - serum and CSF
Anti-neuronal antibody panel (including anti-Hu, anti-Yo, anti-Ri, amphiphysin)
Formal oculomotor assessment with video-oculography to characterize any subtle nystagmus or pursuit asymmetry not detected on bedside exam
served: CSF oligoclonal bands and IgG index
